design_philosophy: The Gen 8 P1 is last year's thin premium mobile workstation, still sold at clearance pricing — the value entry into P1-class build quality. Arc 140T graphics provide entry-level ISV-certified 3D capability in a chassis prioritizing weight, keyboard, and professional manageability over raw GPU throughput.
